title: agonandra obtusifolia subsp. conzattii
intro: Agonandra obtusifolia subsp. conzattii, commonly known as the Mexican agarista, is a plant species belonging to the family Opiliaceae. Research suggests that this plant has various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
